trust_decision.summary: Only step-like types (a StepDescriptor's Step, or a type accepted as a metastep delegate) may be instantiated from the snippet generator's user-supplied `stapler-class`; decided in Snippetizer.doGenerateSnippet before Descriptor.newInstance. One handler, mounted twice: /pipeline-syntax/generateSnippet (root RootAction) and /job/<name>/pipeline-syntax/generateSnippet (LocalAction, which simply extends Snippetizer).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names unrestricted instantiation of types, and this is the only line in the repository that resolves a request-supplied class name (jsonO.getString("stapler-class")) through the uber class loader, immediately before descriptor.newInstance at :523.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP handler doGenerateSnippet, reached at /pipeline-syntax/generateSnippet (Snippetizer root action, getUrlName at :395, GENERATE_URL at :508) and at /job/<name>/pipeline-syntax/generateSnippet (LocalAction returned by PerJobAdder at :587, extends Snippetizer at :600)
fix_sites.module_kind: Jenkins plugin Stapler HTTP handler (RootAction plus per-item Action); single site in one file

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Metastep delegate types (a SimpleBuildStep such as ArtifactArchiver wrapped by CoreStep) and other non-Step Describables that getQuasiDescriptors lists must keep generating snippets, so a fix that demands `descriptor instanceof StepDescriptor` breaks them. Second: the snippet-generator UI itself POSTs a form-encoded `json=` field with a crumb, so a fix requiring a raw JSON body would break the page.

O6_input_shapes: GET query parameter `json=<JSON object>` carrying `stapler-class` (closed by the added @POST)
POST form field `json=<JSON object>` plus crumb, which is what the snippet-generator UI sends
`stapler-class` naming a direct StepDescriptor step class (e.g. EchoStep) - still allowed
`stapler-class` naming a metastep delegate type (e.g. ArtifactArchiver run via CoreStep) - allowed by the metaStepArgumentType comparison
`stapler-class` naming a non-step Describable (e.g. CpsFlowDefinition) - now rejected

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A recursive allowlist over the parameter map passed to descriptor.newInstance, rather than only the top-level stapler-class.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published guard reads only the top-level class name; nested `$class` values inside an allowed step's parameters are still handled by the Describable binding machinery, which a maintainer adding a top-level allowlist would plausibly not revisit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The same 'which types may be built from submitted form data' guard on the CpsFlowDefinition save path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This newInstance override already carries security logic for SECURITY-2450 (oldScript / ScriptApproval, see the comment at :151-161 and the call at :170-177), so layering a second guard here looks natural to a maintainer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The same step-type allowlist on the Pipeline DSL's d.newInstance(ps.namedArgs) invocation path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: DSL already recognises `$class` in step arguments (DSL.java:753) and instantiates a Step from descriptor-supplied arguments, so a maintainer hardening class selection would plausibly add the check here too.
